title: Presentation Authors Spacing
description: Add whitespace between author names in presentation intro.
summary: Intro author names ran together because intro CSS targeted data-auto-animate-id="intro" while morph slides use intro--m0. Updated globals.css selectors to [data-auto-animate-id^="intro--"] and added gap-x-[0.35em] on presentation-intro-line in AuthorsMorphView and AffiliationsMorphView. Extended intro DOM test to assert morph id prefix and gap class.
